repositories.name: agent-intelligence-ecosystem
repositories.description: Canonical registry and governance hub for the MrCakes931 AI Agent Intelligence Ecosystem, including repository manifests, dependencies, standards, audit evidence and release coordination.

repositories.name: agent-ai-discovery
repositories.description: Machine-readable discovery metadata and capability indexes that help AI agents find and evaluate ecosystem resources; discovery metadata does not establish identity or trust.

repositories.name: mrcakes931-ecosystem
repositories.description: Human-facing guide to the MrCakes931 AI Agent Intelligence Ecosystem, with project navigation, onboarding, repository relationships and roadmap.

repositories.name: agent-ecosystem-integration
repositories.description: Integration profiles, adapter safety contracts and conformance checks for interoperable components across the AI Agent Intelligence Ecosystem.

repositories.name: agent-foundation-spec
repositories.description: Normative foundation requirements for agent identity, security, reliability, lifecycle and compatibility across the AI Agent Intelligence Ecosystem.

repositories.name: agent-resource-manifest
repositories.description: Portable, machine-readable manifests for agent tools, skills, models, datasets, services, dependencies and requested permissions.

repositories.name: agent-schema-registry
repositories.description: Versioned JSON Schema catalog and governance conventions for validating interoperable AI agent ecosystem data contracts.

repositories.name: agent-identity-trust
repositories.description: Identity and trust data contracts for agent principals, authentication context, authorization, delegation, revocation and trust boundaries.

repositories.name: agent-secure-supply-chain
repositories.description: Security and integrity contracts for software releases, SBOMs, provenance, dependency review and vulnerability management in agent systems.

repositories.name: agent-policy-engine
repositories.description: Experimental deterministic, default-deny policy evaluator for agent identities, actions, resources and scopes; not a production enforcement boundary.

repositories.name: agent-audit-provenance
repositories.description: Portable audit event contracts and deterministic hash-chained records for traceability; authenticated and signed provenance remain future work.

repositories.name: aix-core
repositories.description: Experimental AIX semantic interoperability specification for agent intents, tasks, responses, capabilities, context, status, errors and provenance.

repositories.name: aix-codecs
repositories.description: Serialization, canonicalization and validation codecs for the AIX interoperability specification, including bounded reference implementations and conformance tests.

repositories.name: agent-transport-gateway
repositories.description: Experimental transport-neutral request guard and integration boundary for AIX over HTTP, MCP and A2A; not a production gateway.

repositories.name: agent-discovery-network
repositories.description: Experimental trust-filtered index of agent, resource and service advertisements; discovery is advisory and does not authenticate or authorize publishers.

repositories.name: agent-capability-registry
repositories.description: Experimental catalog and validator for declared agent capabilities with policy-filtered candidate matching; advisory only, not authentication or authorization.

repositories.name: swarm-runtime
repositories.description: Execution infrastructure contracts and reference components for distributed agent nodes within a hybrid multi-agent swarm architecture.

repositories.name: swarm-coordination
repositories.description: Coordination contracts for task assignment, delegation, acknowledgement, synchronization and recovery across distributed agents.

repositories.name: swarm-state-mesh
repositories.description: Distributed task-state and context synchronization contracts for shared state across a hybrid multi-agent swarm.

repositories.name: osint-source-registry
repositories.description: Review-gated catalog of public information sources and datasets with licensing, permitted-purpose, access-limit, retention and approval metadata; no collection client.

repositories.name: intelligence-knowledge-graph
repositories.description: Provenance-aware graph reference model linking sources, preserved evidence, entities and evidence-backed relationships with explicit uncertainty and bounded queries.

repositories.name: agent-tool-adapters
repositories.description: Experimental Python reference contract for explicit tool-adapter registration, capability declarations, policy-gated invocation and bounded JSON payloads.

repositories.name: agent-skill-library
repositories.description: Experimental declarative skill-package contract and validator for machine-discoverable reusable workflows; no workflow execution or publisher-trust service.

repositories.name: agent-sandbox-security
repositories.description: Experimental sandbox-admission policy contract and fail-closed reference validator; provides no OS-level isolation or workload execution.
